items.title: Reason-coded UNKNOWN envelope
items.problem: A flat unknown_fields list cannot distinguish legitimate absence from recoverable failure.
items.upgrade: Attach versioned unknown_events with reason, provenance, retry, coverage and decision impact.
items.measurement: 100% of contracted UNKNOWN values have a valid reason code.

items.title: Correct coverage denominator
items.problem: not_applicable and diagnostic-only fields can be treated like missing decision evidence.
items.upgrade: Exclude not_applicable and diagnostic_only from coverage and penalties.
items.measurement: Regression fixtures prove no coverage or penalty change from not_applicable fields.

items.title: Preserve UNKNOWN provenance across handoffs
items.problem: Downstream agents receive unknown_fields but not the cause or attempted fallbacks.
items.upgrade: Carry upstream_unknown_events through Giannis, ledger and the frozen fundamental packet.
items.measurement: Same-run source event IDs are visible downstream without mutation.

items.title: SEC XBRL field adapter
items.problem: Fundamental fields currently depend heavily on supplementary normalized data.
items.upgrade: Pilot direct point-in-time SEC Companyfacts/XBRL extraction for cash, debt, revenue, income and cash flow with issuer-specific fact mapping.
items.measurement: Frozen issuer sample coverage, conflict rate and freshness versus current adapter.
items.license_and_cost: official public SEC data; implementation and taxonomy maintenance cost

items.title: FMP supplementary fundamentals route
items.problem: FMP is configured and healthy but is not the current field-level fallback in the scan path.
items.upgrade: Use FMP only as a supplementary fallback and preserve SEC precedence on conflicts.
items.measurement: Incremental coverage, conflicts, latency, quotas and cost on frozen data.
items.license_and_cost: plan and redistribution rights must be verified before public release

items.title: Catalyst content-review queue
items.problem: Foreign issuer reports and generic filings remain category/direction UNKNOWN even when source links exist.
items.upgrade: Route insufficient_source_detail filings to a bounded content review queue with source hash and immutable result.
items.measurement: Classification precision and unresolved rate on a labelled filing fixture set.

items.title: Symbol/CIK/share-class identity gate
items.problem: Provider and filing gaps can originate from ticker identity mismatches.
items.upgrade: Resolve ticker, CIK, exchange, share class and instrument type before collection and quarantine conflicts.
items.measurement: Zero silent cross-issuer joins in identity regression fixtures.

items.title: Field-level bounded retries and cache
items.problem: Temporary outages and true no-coverage states are not consistently separated.
items.upgrade: Apply retry/backoff/cache policies only to retryable reason codes and record every attempt.
items.measurement: Recovery rate, latency and quota cost under injected 429/timeout failures.

items.title: Benzinga fallback
items.problem: The configured Benzinga source currently returns 401.
items.upgrade: Keep disabled until authentication and data rights are deliberately reviewed.
items.measurement: Successful read-only status and documented licensing before pilot.

items.title: LLM value imputation
items.problem: A language model could make UNKNOWN counts look better by inventing plausible values.
items.upgrade: Do not implement. LLMs may classify evidence or request review but never fabricate factual numeric fields.
items.measurement: No generated value can enter a factual field without source identity.
